 October 16, 2026 at 12:15 pm EDT Enter Fullscreen Expand Georgia Alabama Football Georgia linebacker Chris Cole (9) celebrates with the Georgia fans as the final seconds wind off the clock in a win over Alabama during the second half of an NCAA college football game Saturday, Oct. 10, 2026, in Tuscaloosa, Ala. (AP Photo/Vasha Hunt) (Vasha Hunt/AP Photo/Vasha Hunt) October 16, 2026 at 12:15 pm EDT ATLANTA — The University of Alabama Athletics department says it has taken “appropriate action” after a fan was seen shoving a University of Georgia football player.
 No. 1 Georgia defeated No. 6 Alabama in Tuscaloosa Saturday night. Fan tensions escalated after officials decided to not call pass interference against Georgia late in the game. 
 [DOWNLOAD: Free WSB-TV News app for alerts as news breaks ] 
 Channel 2’s Alison Mastrangelo was on the field after the game as Georgia players were leaving. She captured video of Georgia players being told to put their helmets back on while fans were throwing objects onto the field. 
 Another video shared by Dawg Nation showed an Alabama fan hit Georgia linebacker Raylen Wilson on his helmet before shoving his face away. 
 On Thursday, Alabama Athletics released a statement to local media outlets saying that it took action against the fan. 
 “Alabama has identified and taken appropriate action against the individual involved in videos circulating on social media following Saturday night’s football game. We take matters of this nature seriously and will not tolerate this behavior,” the department told AL.com. 
 The statement did not specifically say what kind of action was taken. 
 TRENDING STORIES: 
 No. 1 Georgia is expected to have Nate Frazier return against Auburn 
 SEC week 7: Alabama-Tennessee tops a weekend of ranked showdowns 
 Georgia head coach Kirby Smart addressed the issue earlier this week during his Monday media availability. 
 “I mean, he [Wilson] thought it was a Georgia fan. Probably helps him react the way he did initially,” Smart said. “It’s disappointing behavior by any fan and certainly nothing we condone and I’m sure Alabama doesn’t condone it either.”
 No. 1 Georgia turns the page to its rivalry game with Auburn on Saturday while No. 6 Alabama plays its rivalry game with No. 14 Tennessee.
